name: New York Fed
title: Remote Work from the Office
summary_en: Roughly half of in-office days are spent entirely on Zoom calls or doing solo work according to a new survey of college-educated Americans.
These workers commute in just to work remotely from the office.
Existing measures of remote work that focus solely on working from home miss up to three quarters of its true prevalence.

name: BIS
title: AML/CFT supervisory newsletter
summary_en: This newsletter summarises key themes and challenges discussed in recent supervisory exchanges and workshops related to Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT).

These insights, drawn from supervisory stocktakes and an industry workshop, aim to provide useful perspectives for supervisors and financial institutions in their ongoing efforts to enhance risk management practices.
The Committee believes the information provided may be useful for both supervisors and banks in their day-to-day activities.

name: Kansas City Fed
title: Financially Distressed Consumers May Have Turned to High-Cost Credit to Cope with Inflation
summary_en: Many U.S. consumers, especially those who are financially distressed, have used various strategies to cope with rising prices last year.

Notably, financially distressed consumers were substantially more likely to have taken on additional debt to manage the financial strain of inflation; furthermore, they often borrowed at higher costs.
Higher inflation rates and cuts in federal financial aid this year may compel even more financially distressed consumers to rely on high-cost credit.
